items.title: Perion Exits Nasdaq in $420M Sale to India’s Affle as Open-Web Squeeze Continues
items.desc: Affle is buying Perion for $420 million, but once Perion’s cash is stripped out it’s paying under $200 million for the business, the latest open-web adtech exit at a bargain price.

items.title: Ahead of Midterm Elections, Murdoch Acknowledges Fox News Ratings Struggles
items.desc: Political ad spend across Fox Corp. reached $350 million, a record for a midterm election period.

items.title: Creator Agency LV8 Merges With Sister Firm Mirage, Raises ‘High Eight Figures’
items.desc: Griffin Haddrill, who founded both agencies, plans to use the capital for acquisitions as brand and creator services converge.

items.title: Publicis Closes $2.2 Billion LiveRamp Deal: ‘We Aren’t Worried About Competitors Leaving’
